units.source_text: 家将迅速的剥下这老妪的衣服来；

en.t: The servant quickly stripped the old woman of her clothes.

units.source_text: 而将挽住了他的脚的这老妪，猛烈的踢倒在死尸上。

en.t: Then he violently kicked down the old woman who had clung to his leg, knocking her onto the corpses.
It was only five steps to the stairway entrance.

units.source_text: 家将挟着剥下来的桧皮色的衣服，一瞬间便下了峻急的梯子向昏夜里去了。

en.t: The servant tucked the stripped-off cypress-bark-colored clothing under his arm and, in an instant, went down the steep stairs into the dark night.
